name: Loweemon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and trash 1 card in your hand.
[When Attacking] 1 of your Digimon or Tamers may digivolve into a purple or yellow Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait in your trash.
source_effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, you may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
